top_signals.title: Bond Traders Rush to Hedge Risk of Fed Hikes Stalling Economy
top_signals.summary: Bond traders are racing to hedge the risk that the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate hikes and the stock market’s slide will significantly slow the US economy, forcing the central bank to shift back to easing monetary policy as soon as late next year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Nasdaq 100 Tumbles as Nvidia Euphoria Fades, New Tariffs Loom
top_signals.summary: The Nasdaq 100 Index plunged on Tuesday, led by another steep decline in chipmakers as a relief rally in technology stocks gave way to renewed worries about the durability of the AI trade. Plans for new US tariffs also weighed on stocks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Dell earnings beat on AI strength, company authorizes $25 billion buyback
top_signals.summary: The company's overall sales more than doubled on an annual basis during the third quarter, driven by AI server demand.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Latam Currencies Lag Emerging Peers as Global Selloff Weighs
top_signals.summary: Most Latin American currencies slumped Tuesday as falling metal prices and a renewed selloff in US tech stocks fanned a move away from riskier assets.

top_signals.title: Quant Funds Are Having a Hard Time Keeping Up With This Market
top_signals.summary: The stock market narrative is shifting so quickly, even the so-called fast money can’t keep up.
